hypothesis: Can outcome-conditioned action-selection based on a previously learned causal map outperform both posterior-geometric max-variance acquisition and a FIT-selected strongest passive policy, with identical confirmed effect budgets and learner capacity, across isotropic and anisotropic 16D worlds?
intervention: For each 16D candidate normalized action k, calculate posterior geometry v=k^T P k and model-estimated consequence impact c=||W k||_2^2. Score v*(1+beta*c/(mean_candidate_impact+1e-9)); choose maximum, first-index tie. W and P must come ONLY from earlier confirmed intervention consequences in this SAME task. Before any observed outcome W=0, so falls back exactly to max-variance. No counterfactual, oracle map, heldout query, other task future data or outcome lookahead to policy.

parameter_selection.selected_on: per family and independent FIT seed: min 24-world two-task withheld-query MSE
parameter_selection.geometry_baseline: fixed P101 k^T P k (no parameter)
parameter_selection.passive_baseline: independently choose min FIT MSE of hash_random,cyclic,max_norm on same FIT worlds
parameter_selection.strongest_cal_reference: candidate must beat both the predeclared geometry and FIT-chosen passive; do not switch baseline policy on CAL

source.source_boundary: 8 unseen action candidates offered to every policy; choose one index; only then return selected k and M@k; never return unchosen effects. 16 actual outcomes/world (8 per task).
source.nonreuse: All seeds/salts independent of consumed P101 FIT/CAL and earlier P86-P100, original P101 sources not regenerated for candidate selection.

learner.shared: Exactly P101 regularized RLS W16x16 plus P16x16 float64 with prior=0.5; one independent state/task. Combined persistent 1024 floats; no training except real selected action/effect pairs, same update for all policies.
learner.snapshot: Task0 weights+precision cloned before Task1 and cold restored bitwise, withheld-query read-only
learner.causal_impact_ablation: misaligned input columns of W (reverse column order), same beta FIT, evaluated without CAL retuning; improvement over ablation is exploratory, not posthoc positive criterion

controls: FIT beta choice, no CAL tuning
future oracle maps withheld from chooser
all policies same 16 factual outcome calls per world and same 1024 learned float64 values

acceptance.primary: mean 2-task novel withheld 16D effect MSE CAL per independently pinned seed, candidate ratio to EACH (geometry and FIT-selected passive) <=0.90, not a CAL-selected baseline
acceptance.mild_anisotropy: report all three seeds and median as independent gradient diagnostic, no claim of general trend from posthoc slicing

qualification.output: same G4 full pytest writes local_runs/p102_dev_result.json with candidate SHA and run ID; no new workflows, no duplicate science runs
